build_dataset_from_args: build a JSONLDataset from argparse args using the Dataset.build class method
register_dataset: register a new dataset with a name, path, and build callback in the Dataset registry
iterate_jsonl_prompts: iterate over JSONL files yielding Prompt objects with text and metadata fields
add_dataset_args: add required --dataset and --dataset-dir arguments to an argparse ArgumentParser
create_prompt_dataclass: create a Prompt dataclass instance with text and meta dictionary attributes
